title: The federated sign-in was refused
background: This service refuses rather than accepting at this address, which is the opposite of what it does elsewhere. What arrives here is an unauthenticated request claiming to be a person, and the session it would start is the one every other protocol of this service reads, so anything this service cannot verify is refused.
recorded: The refusal is recorded on the federation relationship as fedLastError, and as a row in the audit log.
